review: Personally read the whole scan and both halves, then every line and both diagrams against C and H. All main blocks were enlarged at 3×, the top diagram at 4×, and individual doubtful or differing groups at 5× or 6×; the black obliteration in condition b was examined at 8×. The cancelled left marginal map was viewed at 6× and rotated clockwise 6° to align the surviving baseline. Formula letters, exponents, primes, arrows, finite and directed limits, the table bracket and inserted torsor qualification were checked. The counterexample exponent remains explicitly doubtful despite the familiar mathematical form. No context was opened.
